doc: Ch8 tunables (M3-C08-02; act1_ch08.md; docs/kb/tech/chapter_flow.md 'Ch8'). mend: Ch08Zone.mend() between the set piece's waves raises each party member's carried HP to at least hp_pct of their battle maximum (act1_ch08.md §5a: 'at least 50% HP', no MP); the maximum is built as a live battle builds it, on `encounter`. trial: Coilspire's flue trial (CoilspireTrial; Ch08CoilspireZone). Each tier lists its flue-keys and the keys whose opening draws the flame up (draw); a key outside the draw splits the draught and resets the tier. Tier 2's side flue draws only alone and opens the lamp-niche (niche_flag). Tier 3's seized key turns only after seized_beat (Liss, seized_hero) has set seized_flag. tiers_flag is numeric (tiers climbed); crown_flag opens the crown door. hint_scene plays once a tier after hint_sec idle (act1_ch08.md B05: 90 s). key_turn_deg turns an open key's greybox block.
